title: For instance display names that have a number of completed migrations great
question: For instance display names that have a number of completed migrations greater than the average completed-migration count across all instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata, list the display name and its completed migration count.     SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count
    FROM instances i

    WHERE m.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name
),

    SELECT AVG(imc.completed_migration_count) AS avg_count

)
SELECT imc.display_name, imc.completed_migration_count
FROM instance_migration_counts imc
CROSS JOIN avg_completed_migrations acm
